rds_backup_retention.why_it_matters: A BackupRetentionPeriod of 0 disables automated backups, and a window shorter than seven days leaves no recovery point for a problem that is noticed a few days late.
rds_backup_retention.recommendation: Set BackupRetentionPeriod to at least 7 so that point in time recovery covers a full week.

rds_deletion_protection.why_it_matters: DeletionProtection defaults to false, so an accidental stack update or stack delete can remove the instance and its automated backups.
rds_deletion_protection.recommendation: Set DeletionProtection to true on the DB instance.

s3_deletion_policy.why_it_matters: Without a DeletionPolicy, the S3 bucket and all its objects are permanently deleted when the CloudFormation stack is deleted.
s3_deletion_policy.recommendation: Add DeletionPolicy: Retain to the S3 bucket resource.

s3_versioning_enabled.why_it_matters: Without versioning, overwritten or accidentally deleted objects cannot be recovered.

rds_multi_az.why_it_matters: A single-AZ RDS instance is a single point of failure; an AZ outage causes downtime.
rds_multi_az.recommendation: Set MultiAZ to true for production workloads.

dynamodb_pitr.why_it_matters: Without PITR, a table can only be restored from manual backups, not to an arbitrary point in time.

secrets_rotation.why_it_matters: A secret without rotation accumulates exposure risk over its lifetime.

lambda_dlq.why_it_matters: Without a DLQ, failed Lambda invocations are lost with no opportunity for retry or analysis.
lambda_dlq.recommendation: Add DeadLetterConfig with a TargetArn pointing to an SQS queue or SNS topic.

lambda_timeout.why_it_matters: The default 3-second timeout causes premature termination for any non-trivial workload.
lambda_timeout.recommendation: Set Timeout to a value appropriate for the function (typically 30-300 seconds).

asg_multi_az.why_it_matters: An ASG in a single AZ is a single point of failure at the zone level.
asg_multi_az.recommendation: Spread across at least two AZs via AvailabilityZones or VPCZoneIdentifier.

ec2_ebs_optimized.why_it_matters: Without EBS optimization, I/O throughput competes with network traffic on the same channel.
